task.title: Correct mismatched plot-data length validation
task.description: Repair the deliberately incorrect same-length comparison in create_plot and satisfy pytest and the MCP-backed SonarQube quality gate.
requirements: Make create_plot compare the lengths of x_data and y_data rather than comparing x_data with itself.
Raise a descriptive ValueError when the two data sequences have different lengths.
Add a focused pytest regression test for mismatched data lengths so the repaired validation branch remains covered.
Preserve the existing CSV validation, successful plotting behavior, and public API.
Do not change sonar-project.properties, quality-gate rules, analysis scope, or tests merely to suppress the finding.
acceptance_criteria: The existing pytest suite passes before review.
The MCP-backed review records successful quality-gate, issue, and Security Hotspot tool calls.
The first SonarQube review reports a failed quality gate for the duplicated comparison.
The graph repairs the comparison and adds regression coverage.
The final tests and MCP-backed SonarQube quality gate pass.
No Sonar suppression or validation weakening is introduced.

approval.content: Correct create_plot's duplicated length comparison so mismatched x_data and y_data raise a descriptive ValueError. Add a focused regression test that covers the error branch. Preserve the public API and existing behavior. Do not change or suppress SonarQube configuration; let the MCP-backed review verify the repair.

code.content: The starting fixture deliberately checks len(x_data) against len(x_data), so unequal y_data is never rejected. Change the right-hand expression to len(y_data), retain the descriptive ValueError, and add a mismatched-length regression test.
